decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core cheese range that outlasted other 2018 launches, it likely performs above the firm's aspiration level relative to comparable products, so management would keep it unless newer evidence shows a clear shortfall.

Although the spicy variant is more niche and therefore somewhat more vulnerable if sales fall below aspiration, its survival beyond the first review period suggests acceptable results and enough confidence to keep it for now.

The mild creamy soft cheese fits the firm's organic dairy identity and appears to have survived the firm's early product pruning, indicating performance likely near or above aspiration and supporting continuation.
